title: Cone
spec: To construct the rectangular base for the cone, start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.1725). The third line runs from (0.75, 0.1725) to (0.0, 0.1725), and the fourth line completes the loop by returning to the origin. After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to reduce the size of the rectangle. To transform the two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object, rotate it using the same Euler angles and translate it with the same vector. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0075 units to create a solid body. This results in a rectangular base with a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.1725 units, and a height of 0.0075 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.1725) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1725) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a 3D object
r = r.extrude(0.0075)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
